verdict.rationale: Otter lists "Otter API & Webhooks" on its pricing page and describes a Public API for custom integrations. Its MCP server gives OAuth-authenticated access to transcripts and action items, so programmatic access to meeting data exists. However, the evidence never shows API reference docs, which endpoints return transcripts, summaries or action items, or self-serve key issuance, and the API looks tied to a pricing tier. Missing for 10: documented API reference covering transcripts/summaries/action items, self-serve API key generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of script-based access.
